description: The compilation digitises Alberta Research Council hydrogeological maps created during 1971–1983. Geologists used water-well information and sediment properties to assign yield values to mapped zones, generally considering materials down to 305 metres. The provincial geodatabase retains yield polygons and likely formation name, age and lithology. The metadata also describes source shapefiles. These are historical water-supply well-yield estimates, not measured current pumping capacity. The package dates extend to 2008, while the description identifies the older mapping period. Numerical yields and field definitions were not inspected. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
